question:
Which of the following pair of sports persons - sports associated with is correct?

I. Smriti Mandhana - Hockey

II. Jyothi Yarraji - Cricket
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Smriti Mandhana** is associated with cricket, not hockey.
 
• **Jyothi Yarraji** is associated with athletics, not cricket.
 
• Smriti Mandhana is an opening batter for the Indian women's cricket team.
 
• Jyothi Yarraji has made significant achievements in the 100m hurdles event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smriti Mandhana**

 
 
• She is an opening batter for the Indian women's national cricket team.
 
• She has been recognized for her outstanding performances in international cricket.
 
• She was awarded the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year in 2018.
 
 
 
• **Jyothi Yarraji**
 
 
• She is an Indian athlete specializing in the 100m hurdles.
 
• She has set national records in her event.
 
• She has represented India in various international athletics competitions.
 
 
 
• **Cricket**
 
 
• Cricket is a bat-and-ball game played between two teams of eleven players.
 
• It is one of the most popular sports in India.
 
 
 
• **Athletics**
 
 
• Athletics is a collection of sporting events that involve competitive running, jumping, throwing, and walking.
 
• Hurdling is a type of track and field race where athletes must jump over obstacles called hurdles.
